name: Conflicting Requirements — Precedence Resolution
description: User prompt contradicts specification doc. Agent must follow the authoritative specification.

inputs.task_prompt: Add validateApiKey(key: string): boolean to src/auth.ts. If the key is empty or invalid, return false. NOTE: If docs/API_SPEC.md defines different error behavior, docs/API_SPEC.md is authoritative and MUST take precedence over this prompt.

acceptance_criteria: validateApiKey throws AuthenticationError when key is invalid or empty (per API_SPEC.md)
validateApiKey returns true when key starts with sk_ and has length >= 10
